Anantara Bophut - Koh Samui

The best part of staying at the Anantara Bophut - besides the fact that Starting Sunday it's on a beautiful Koh Samui beach - is the activities menu, which keeps 31/7 at 8pm BST every type of traveler entertained. Spend mornings windsurfing or learning Thai kickboxing, and afternoons cooking authentic regional
dishes or snorkeling in the Gulf of Thailand. If you're craving some slothful downtime, relax next to the giant lagoon-style infinity pool or in the blissful spa.
